requirement R1 A valid 2-level chain: the leaf is signed directly by a trust anchor
requirement R2 A valid 3-level chain: leaf, one intermediate, then a trust anchor
requirement R3 The last certificate's issuer key isn't one of the given trust anchors: unknown-anchor
requirement R4 A certificate in the chain was not really signed by the next one up: bad-signature
requirement R5 An intermediate in the chain lacks CA:true: not-a-ca
requirement R6 An intermediate's path length constraint is violated by how many more intermediates follow it: path-too-long
requirement R7 A certificate's validity window does not cover `now`: expired
requirement E2E A realistic small set of chains, mirroring what let browsers reject paths through the revoked eMudhra intermediates
